findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: marketplace_list_signal, ccs_validate, ccs_info, autopilot_stop, oracle_query, citation_score · Private data: bureau_public_score, hiring_post_job, ccs_validate, ccs_score, ccs_report, autopilot_start, settlement_browse, post_to_slack, agent_economy · Public sink: verify_payment, marketplace_list_signal, hiring_post_job, ccs_validate, post_to_slack · Destructive: convergence_check, circuit_breaker_reset, narrative_optimize.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: marketplace_list_signal, ccs_validate, ccs_info, autopilot_stop, oracle_query, citation_score · Private data: bureau_public_score, hiring_post_job, ccs_validate, ccs_score, ccs_report, autopilot_start, settlement_browse, post_to_slack, agent_economy · Public sink: verify_payment, marketplace_list_signal, hiring_post_job, ccs_validate, post_to_slack · Destructive: convergence_check, circuit_breaker_reset, narrative_optimize

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
